notes: Removes the Market weapon-description MutationObserver entirely. Watching document.body during Market construction could still produce a mutation storm and lock the Foundry client even after card writes were made idempotent.

Weapon-description synchronization now runs only in short scheduled bursts after user clicks and on module initialization, which still catches Shop open, DETAILS, filters, rerolls, and shop changes without observing its own DOM writes.
Canonical FEHA weapon descriptions and Mk suppression remain active in the Market.
No Market stock, prices, weapon balance, DEX rules, reload cadence, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
